idea-plugin.name: Livewire 3 Upgrade Blocker Lint
idea-plugin.description:
The Livewire 2 lines that die quietly in Livewire 3 — named, with the v3 replacement beside each

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Livewire 3 Upgrade Blocker Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 15 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/livewire3-upgrade-blocker-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/livewire3-upgrade-blocker-lint
